markerChecks.reason: The clean source foundation must remain pinned to its immutable upstream commit, tree, ref, lockfile, and Dockerfile receipts.
Both the Mhoo contract and explicit upstream fallback must remain present in the canonical shared preset file.
The approved packet identity, entity, and fail-closed DPA state must remain explicit; per-file bytes and hashes are enforced by the dedicated verifier.
The supplied raster source and its no-vector-drift decision are part of asset custody.
Distribution metadata must preserve the governed upstream revision and license while displaying Mhoo.
Helm helper names remain stable technical identifiers while brand values are configurable.
The clean foundation keeps the upstream package and license identifiers intact.
Distribution metadata changes must not silently remove the inherited license identity.
